universe: r_def = 00, c_res 1 or 3, age 15-98, employed (clase2 = 1); annual = sum of fac_tri over 4 quarters / 4
definition: Own-account workers and employers (pos_ocu 2-3) whose workplace has up to 10 people (p3q 01-03), the template fallback; ENAMIN was discontinued after 2012.

notes.M4_digital: No 2025 source (Censos Económicos 2024 refer to 2023; left out to keep one period).
notes.M6: Not sales: ENOE has no business sales question; this is the owner's labour income, labelled as such.
notes.size_limit: Up to 10 people: ENOE p3q bands give 1, 2-5, 6-10, so the template limit of 9 cannot be applied.
